title: Check Domain Availability
description: Check whether a domain name is available for purchase on Namecheap and note its price.
outcome: The user knows whether the domain is available and what it costs.
when_to_use: When exploring new domain names for a project.

steps.description: Namecheap's domain search is the starting point for every availability check.
steps.verify: The Namecheap homepage loads with the domain search box visible.

steps.action: Type the domain name into the search box
steps.description: The search box accepts a full domain or a keyword; type the exact domain to get an exact-match result.
steps.verify: The search box shows the typed domain name.

steps.description: Submitting the search opens the results page with the exact match listed first.
steps.verify: The results page lists the domain with an availability badge.

steps.action: Read the availability and price of the exact match
steps.description: The first row is the exact match; its badge says whether it can be registered and its price is the first-year cost.
steps.verify: The first row shows either an Add to cart button with a price or a Make offer / Taken label.

success_criteria: The availability status and price of the domain are known

variables.name: domain_name
variables.validation: A domain name such as example.com

common_errors: If Namecheap shows a captcha, solve it and search again
